name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and manages Nginx for three SSL-enabled static sites, including site roots, virtual hosts, security headers, compression, logging, redirects, TLS certificates, Fail2ban, firewall rules, SSH hardening, and network hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and enables Memcached and Redis, creates the Redis log directory, configures Redis on port 6379, and applies the required post-generation configuration adjustments.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys the FastAPI tutorial application with Python dependencies, a virtual environment, PostgreSQL database and user initialization, application environment configuration, and a systemd-managed Uvicorn service on port 8000.
